name: Hiougi Shizumu
source:
He is the young chief priest. He is calm and carefree. He is always smiling and laughing, but his ability as a priest is immeasurable.

He was hospitalized after an accident on Masakazu's first day of work.

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_miko2.htm]official site[/url]]
